View our clinical guidelines. Policies AmeriHealth Caritas DC utilizes InterQual Criteria to guide medical necessity determinations. Requests that are not addressed by, or do not meet, the medical necessity guidelines are referred to the Medical Director for a decision. During review, the Medical Director utilizes these clinical policies, which are intended to provide the most comprehensive health solutions for our AmeriHealth Caritas DC enrollees. View our clinical policies. Preventive health resources AmeriHealth Caritas DC wants to partner with you to prevent enrollee illnesses by delivering the best preventive care.
